title: [review] messaging.py:144: _next_id counter never updated
description: The render_post method computes candidate_next_id but never writes it back to self._next_id. Lines 137-144 calculate the next ID value into a local variable, but there is no self._next_id = candidate_next_id statement. Result: every auto-assigned message gets ID 1, each subsequent POST without explicit ID overwrites the previous message in self._sent, causing silent data loss.
close_reason: Fixed: Added self.deliver(body) call in render_post. The _next_id assignment was already in place at line 145. The missing deliver call was lost during a refactoring - it was present in the original code (commit a835e61089) but removed when sent tracking was added. All 60 messaging tests now pass.
